promotion_rule: Do not mark any item confirmed until all supporting evidence locators are independently checked against the rendered PDFs.

items.topic: Decoder superiority: diffusion versus BP-OSD/BP-family methods
items.observation: Both works motivate alternatives to standard BP-family decoding and include BP-OSD-related comparisons, but their claims cannot yet be treated as contradictory or directly ranked.
likely_explanations: different code instances or code families
training and inference costs excluded from one comparison
different failure definitions or sample counts
items.required_resolution: Reconstruct a matched benchmark table from the cited figures/tables and rerun both methods on identical code/noise instances.

items.topic: Generalizing BB-code performance across erasure and non-erasure noise
items.observation: BiBiEQ focuses on erasure/circuit-level behavior, while the other BB papers emphasize code construction or transversal-gate properties. Performance claims are not interchangeable across these regimes.
items.required_resolution: Create a common BB code set and evaluate it under erasure, depolarizing, biased, and circuit-level models with fixed decoders.

items.topic: Fast decoding versus broad QLDPC applicability
items.observation: Union-find-style decoding emphasizes efficient local cluster processing for surface codes, while BPGD and diffusion target broader QLDPC settings. Speed claims should not be compared without accounting for code structure and hardware parallelism.
items.required_resolution: Define throughput, latency, memory, and accuracy metrics and benchmark representative surface, hypergraph-product, and BB codes on the same hardware.

items.topic: Code-quality optimization versus fault-tolerant gate structure
items.observation: Search for favorable coprime BB parameters and imposition of self-duality/transversal Clifford structure may optimize different objectives and could introduce tradeoffs in rate, distance, layout, or decoder performance.
likely_explanations: additional algebraic constraints reduce the search space
items.required_resolution: Generate matched code families with and without self-duality and compare rate, distance, stabilizer weight, layout, gate set, and decoding performance.
